title: Wise Words
subtitle: WITH MARCO REYES  ·  WISE WORDS

segments.head: WISE WORDS TONIGHT
segments.author: Tonight's show
lines: Good evening, everyone!
I'm Marco Reyes, and this is Wise Words.
Tonight, I've got six famous sayings from very clever people.
And I'll explain each one so simply, a ten-year-old would get it.
Ready? Let's go.

segments.head: STORY 1: KEEP PEDALLING
segments.quote: Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep your balance you must keep moving.
segments.author: Albert Einstein
lines: Our first story comes from Albert Einstein, the famous scientist.
He said: Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep your balance, you must keep moving.
Remember learning to ride a bike?
When you stop pedalling, you wobble, and you fall.
But when you keep going, you stay up!
Life is the same. When things feel wobbly, keep pedalling.

segments.head: STORY 2: TAKE THE SHOT
segments.quote: You miss 100% of the shots you don't take.
segments.author: Wayne Gretzky
lines: Next, from ice hockey star Wayne Gretzky.
You miss one hundred percent of the shots you don't take.
That means, if you never try, you can never score.
Scared to speak up in the meeting? Scared to apply for that job?
Take the shot. You might miss. But you might score!

segments.head: STORY 3: SLOW IS OKAY
segments.quote: It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
segments.author: Confucius
lines: Now, a very old saying, from a teacher called Confucius, who lived in China long, long ago.
It does not matter how slowly you go, as long as you do not stop.
Some people get there fast. Some get there slowly. That's okay!
Just like the tortoise in the story, slow and steady still gets to the finish line.

segments.head: STORY 4: SMALL KINDNESS
segments.quote: No act of kindness, no matter how small, is ever wasted.
segments.author: Aesop
lines: Our next story comes from Aesop, who told fables. Those are little stories with animals in them.
He said: No act of kindness, no matter how small, is ever wasted.
In his story, a big lion lets a tiny mouse go free.
Later, the mouse chews through a hunter's net, and saves the lion!
So hold the door. Say hello to the new person at work.
Small kindness always comes back around.

segments.head: STORY 5: LEARNING IS A SUPERPOWER
segments.quote: Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world.
segments.author: Nelson Mandela
lines: From South Africa, Nelson Mandela said:
Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world.
Now, don't worry. He didn't mean a real weapon.
He meant that learning is like a superpower.
Every book you read, and every new skill you pick up, makes you stronger.

segments.head: STORY 6: ONE PERSON
segments.quote: One child, one teacher, one book and one pen can change the world.
segments.author: Malala Yousafzai
lines: And finally, Malala Yousafzai, who stood up for girls going to school.
She said: One child, one teacher, one book, and one pen, can change the world.
And that one person... could be you.

segments.head: THAT'S ALL FOR TONIGHT
segments.quote: Keep pedalling. Take your shot. Never stop. Be kind. Keep learning.
segments.author: Marco Reyes
lines: That's all the wise words for tonight.
Keep pedalling. Take your shot. Never stop. Be kind. And keep learning.
I'm Marco Reyes. Good night, and sleep well.
